source: Rust client asset bundles (content.bundle + assetscenes.bundle), live procedural spawn handler spawn.procmap.v3, read with scripts/extract-ore-tables.py
notes: Filters: biome/splat are bitmasks of channel indices (biome: arid=1 temperate=2 tundra=4 arctic=8 jungle=16; splat: dirt=1 snow=2 sand=4 rock=8 grass=16 forest=32 stones=64 gravel=128). splat -1 = any.

Ore mix per folder: resource/ores has PrefabParameters.Count=2 on Stone-Ore (others default 1). Sulfur-Ore's PrefabWeight{Scale 0.5, Era 10} only applies in the Primitive era (Facepunch: 'Less Sulfur Nodes Spawn (50%)'), so vanilla weight is 1.
